answer: Charge admission in something irreversible: every agent posts a stake of attestations from identities already anchored in the chain. A vault door cut from basalt is heavy to move and expensive to carve; a fresh sock puppet cannot borrow that reputation, since the original attesters would have to countersign the clone and burn their own standing if it misbehaves. Add decay - stakes renew each epoch like polishing ivory, and dormant clones fade. At the zenith, one attack costs more than it could ever harvest.
